##### Project general facts

Hadley Heights is a beautifully conceived modern residential complex where luxury, elegance and contemporary living come together in perfect harmony. Rising across twenty-two residential floors above a ground level and four dedicated parking levels, the tower is served by three passenger elevators and a service elevator, along with generous covered podium parking. Residents can choose from elegantly designed studio, one bedroom and two bedroom apartments, each offering a wonderful blend of bright, convenient spaces crafted with the utmost attention to detail.

Life here is enriched by a truly impressive collection of world-class amenities spread across landscaped pool terraces, play zones, a nature garden and a health and wellbeing zone. The pool terraces feature a swimming pool with a pool deck, a dedicated kids pool, a shallow pool with a baja shelf, daybed platforms, private cabanas and pool showers, while families enjoy indoor and outdoor kids play areas, a games zone with table tennis, outdoor mini golf and shaded seating. Completing the offering are a state-of-the-art fitness centre with a yoga space, sauna rooms, changing rooms and spa, a pocket garden with barbeque pit and picnic tables, and a serene main lobby with contemporary co-working lounges and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the building.

The interiors are a joy to come home to, with open-plan living areas designed for maximum comfort and relaxation and finished with stylish, modern furnishings. Each contemporary kitchen is built around meticulous detail and superb finishing, featuring built-in appliances, elegant countertops and a breakfast counter that doubles beautifully as a workstation. The bedrooms are elegant and inviting with heightened ceilings, large sunlit windows and generous wardrobe storage, while the spa-like bathrooms showcase high-quality fixtures and accessories, mirror cabinets, crisp wall tiling and plush porcelain flooring.

##### Location description and benefits 

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a vibrant residential community in Dubai, known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of modern urban living and tranquil suburban ambiance. Situated in the heart of new Dubai, JVC offers a blend of villas, townhouses, and apartments, making it an attractive location for both families and young professionals. The area is designed to provide residents with a sense of community, with its wide range of amenities including parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, all within easy reach.

The architecture in JVC is a blend of traditional Arabian and modern styles, contributing to its unique charm. The community is well-connected to key areas of Dubai through major highways like Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it convenient for residents to commute to work, school, or entertainment hubs. The community's layout is thoughtfully planned, with lush green spaces, walking paths, and communal areas that encourage outdoor activities and social interaction.

In addition to residential options, JVC is home to a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and leisure facilities, ensuring that residents have everything they need close at hand. The ongoing development in the area continues to enhance its appeal, making JVC a sought-after location for those looking to experience a balanced lifestyle in the bustling city of Dubai.
